summary: Specific performance of agreement to sell; agricultural land dispute; Agreement to Sell dated 30.08.1990; payment of full consideration; possession delivered; subsequent illegal alienation despite injunction; HUF ownership defense rejected; urban area defense examined; mutation orders challenged; appellate interference with Trial Court findings improper; specific performance granted; High Court reversal overturned.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Trial Court decree restored; respondents directed to execute sale deeds.
